description: Step 2 of 3: verifies a claim. With code: checks the mailed code (send_claim_code). Without: checks the DNS TXT record, then the meta tag, then the file. A newly verified product gets its free check queued (private: nothing shows in the directory until a drive). Every order but the free check needs a verified claim on the domain.
